annotations.title: Pieces that pair with a product

description: Pieces in stock that style well with one product, grouped by outfit role (top, bottom, dress, shoes, layer, bag), skipping the product's own role, with pieces made for this month's weather in that market first. Narrow by colour season, occasion, formality, style, colour and price. Use it to build two or three outfits around a product id from search_clothes or get_product.

country.description: Two-letter shopping country, e.g. se, no, gb, us.

max_price.description: Highest price in the country's currency.

occasions.description: What it is for, e.g. work, party, vacation.

season.description: Optional. One of the 12 colour seasons; leave out to search everything, or it uses the saved season of a signed-in person.
